summary.business_type: SaaS — free AI YouTube SEO tool (SoftwareApplication) with programmatic SEO glossary (EN/ES/PT), blog, and interactive tools
top_findings: Sitemap is ~29% broken: 23/80 sampled /glossary/ URLs return HTTP 404 (~3,000+ of 10,986 listed), incl. the 255-URL 'channel-optimization-for-small-channels' family
Blog JSON-LD still unparseable on ~50% of sampled posts (unescaped HTML inside JSON strings) — Article+FAQPage rich results are broken on the newest content
24 identical /blog/* vs /tools/* slug pairs competing for the same keywords (cannibalization), both indexable
E-E-A-T vacuum persists: /about noindex, anonymous authorship, Gmail contact, empty 'Trusted by' section, AI-template blog titles ('Learn how to X 2026')
5 noindex core URLs (/dashboard, /about, /changelog, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service) still listed in sitemap; only 49/11,096 URLs have <lastmod>
Content-Security-Policy blocks third-party scripts: Vercel Analytics (cdn.jsdelivr.net) console error + Google AdSense (pagead2.googlesyndication.com) won't load
Blog hero image alt attributes are corrupted by glossary-link HTML injection on some posts; one post still hotlinks picsum.photos
quick_wins: Remove 404 glossary URLs + noindex core URLs from sitemap.xml and regenerate (single deploy, removes ~29% of broken sitemap)
Fix blog JSON-LD escaping in the post template (json_encode the strings) — restores rich results on all posts
Pick one home per cannibalized slug: 301 /tools/* article shells to /blog/* (24 pairs)
Add lastmod to glossary URLs in the sitemap generator (11,047 URLs missing it)
Add pagead2.googlesyndication.com + cdn.jsdelivr.net to CSP script-src so AdSense and analytics load
Add security.txt + make /about indexable with a named founder/author

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS + HSTS (preload) on all routes; Vercel CDN with proper cache headers (immutable assets, max-age=0 for HTML)
robots.txt clean: blocks only internal paths, allows all major AI crawlers (ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot)
Core pages return 200; canonical tags present; the prior 6,400 glossary 500-errors are FIXED (vs-pages now render 200)
llms.txt (200) and llms-full.txt (33KB, 200) now live
hreflang en/es/pt/x-default correctly implemented on multilingual glossary pages

findings.title: Sitemap contains ~29% broken (404) URLs
findings.description: 11,096 URLs in sitemap.xml; 10,986 are /glossary/. Sampling 80 random glossary URLs: 23 return HTTP 404 (28.75%). The 'channel-optimization-for-small-channels' family alone accounts for 255 dead URLs (all 404). Extrapolated: ~3,000+ broken URLs are submitted to Google.
findings.recommendation: Audit and either generate the missing glossary combos or 301/410 them; regenerate sitemap from live-verified URLs only. Add an automated broken-link check to CI.

findings.title: 5 noindex core pages listed in sitemap
findings.description: /dashboard, /about, /changelog, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service all return robots noindex/nofollow yet appear in sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Exclude noindex URLs from the sitemap generator (or make /about indexable, see E-E-A-T).

findings.title: Missing <lastmod> on 99.5% of URLs
findings.description: Only 49 of 11,096 URLs carry <lastmod>. Google cannot detect freshness for the glossary.
findings.recommendation: Emit lastmod (and ideally changefreq) for glossary entries in the sitemap generator.

findings.title: Security header gaps + missing security.txt
findings.description: X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options (nosniff), and Referrer-Policy are absent from responses. /.well-known/security.txt and /security.txt return 404.
findings.recommendation: Add XFO (SAMEORIGIN), nosniff, Referrer-Policy to vercel.json headers; publish a security.txt.

findings.title: Stray placeholder + dead routes
findings.description: /blog/generic-hero returns HTTP 200 with 16 bytes (placeholder template page) and /guide returns 404. /pricing redirects to the noindex dashboard shell.
findings.recommendation: noindex or delete /blog/generic-hero; fix or remove /guide; build a real indexable /pricing page.

findings.title: CSP blocks first-party analytics
findings.description: Console error: loading @vercel/analytics from cdn.jsdelivr.net violates the CSP script-src. AdSense (pagead2.googlesyndication.com) is likewise not whitelisted.
findings.recommendation: Whitelist cdn.jsdelivr.net, pagead2.googlesyndication.com (script), googleads.g.doubleclick.net + tpc.googlesyndication.com (frame) in the CSP.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog posts are substantive (2,000-10,500 words with structured H2 sections, FAQ blocks, and internal tool links)
Multilingual glossary (EN/ES/PT) with real definitions and Article schema
llms.txt + llms-full.txt provide a comprehensive AI-facing content map
Interlinking between blog and tools exists (blog-enhancements.js injects glossary links)

findings.title: E-E-A-T vacuum on a YMYL-adjacent niche
findings.description: /about is noindex with no named founder/author; authorship is brand-only; contact is a Gmail address; legal entity absent from privacy/ToS; homepage 'Trusted by' section shows no verifiable logos.
findings.recommendation: Publish an indexable About page with a named founder, consistent author bylines on posts, business email/address, and remove unverifiable 'Trusted by' claims.

findings.title: Scaled AI-template content risk
findings.description: Many blog posts follow the template 'Learn how to {keyword} 2026...' with near-identical phrasing; 58 blog posts + 10,986 programmatic glossary pages is high-volume automated output.
findings.recommendation: Add a human review/fact-check gate to the publishing workflow; differentiate post intros/outros; cite sources for data claims.

findings.title: Thin pages in 3 templates
findings.description: Tools pages: 109-172 words, H2=0 (12 sampled); blog category hubs: 74-82 words; glossary vs-pages: 300-490 words of boilerplate ('How to Optimize' blocks).
findings.recommendation: Expand tool pages with how-to steps, examples, and FAQ; flesh out category hubs; vary glossary copy per term.

findings.title: Multiple H1s on one post
findings.description: /blog/maximizing-youtube-revenue-with-sponsorships-2026 contains 6 H1 tags (198KB, 10,545 words).
findings.recommendation: Demote to H2/H3 in the template/regenerator and re-render the post.

findings.title: Broken llms.txt entry + stale counts
findings.description: llms.txt lists a '[null]' entry pointing to /blog/generic-hero and states 'Blog Posts (18)' and '95 tools' while the live sitemap shows 58 blog posts and 37 tool URLs.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate llms.txt from live content with accurate counts; drop the generic-hero entry.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Single H1 on nearly all pages; meta descriptions present on 49/50 sampled URLs
Canonical tags on core and content pages; keyword-rich titles
50 internal links on homepage; blog hub links to 47 posts
Googlebot receives identical HTML to browsers (static prerender — no SPA wall)

findings.title: Title tags too long on blog and tools
findings.description: Sampled blog titles run 62-96 chars (8 of 14 >60), tools titles 63-94 chars. Google truncates at ~60 (desktop) / ~50-55 (mobile).
findings.recommendation: Trim titles to <=60 chars in the generators; front-load the keyword.

findings.title: Alt attribute corrupted by glossary-link injection
findings.description: On some blog posts the hero image alt contains raw HTML (<a href="/glossary/youtube-shorts" class="glossary-link">...) — the glossary cross-linker is injecting links inside alt attributes, producing broken markup.
findings.recommendation: Make the glossary-link injection ignore attributes (only inject into visible text nodes); re-render affected posts.

findings.title: Blog/tools slug cannibalization
findings.description: 24 identical slugs exist under both /blog/ and /tools/ (e.g. youtube-intro-hook-first-3-seconds, youtube-tags-2026), both indexable with different templates.
findings.recommendation: Designate one canonical home per keyword (recommend /blog/ for articles, /tools/ only for interactive tools) and 301/canonical the losers.

findings.title: Weak meta descriptions on some pages
findings.description: A few meta descriptions are short (61-99 chars) or missing entirely (tools/description-writer has none).
findings.recommendation: Enforce 120-160 char descriptions across templates.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Homepage JSON-LD valid and rich: Organization (+logo.png), WebSite, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList
Tool pages emit WebApplication; /vs/ pages emit FAQPage; glossary emits Article — all parseable
Blog posts with valid blocks include Article + FAQPage + SpeakableSpecification

findings.title: Blog JSON-LD broken on ~50% of sampled posts
findings.description: 7 of 14 sampled posts have unparseable ld+json blocks (e.g. youtube-intro-hook 4/5, youtube-metadata-auditor-vs-vidiq-shadow-ban 1/3, youtube-analytics-4-metrics 1/2) — unescaped HTML in JSON strings breaks Article+FAQPage.
findings.recommendation: Use a real JSON serializer in the blog template (json.dumps/htmlspecialchars), re-render affected posts, and add a schema validation step to CI.

findings.title: SearchAction points to login-gated /dashboard
findings.description: WebSite SearchAction target is https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/dashboard?q={search_term_string} which is noindex and requires login for search results.
findings.recommendation: Point SearchAction at an indexable search surface or remove it.

findings.title: Hub pages lack list schema
findings.description: No ItemList/BreadcrumbList on /blog, /tools, /glossary hubs; no DefinedTerm on glossary entries.
findings.recommendation: Add ItemList to hub templates and DefinedTerm to glossary terms.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Homepage HTML is lean (71KB); zero tags on homepage keeps layout stable
Vercel CDN edge caching; immutable hashed asset names; static prerender (no client-side render wall for Googlebot)
Only 3 external scripts on homepage; preconnects/dns-prefetches declared

findings.title: No field CWV data available
findings.description: CrUX/GSC credentials are not configured (google_auth --check: tier -1), so LCP/INP/CLS cannot be scored from field data in this audit.
findings.recommendation: Connect a Google API key (GOOGLE_API_KEY) so future audits pull CrUX field data; meanwhile run Lighthouse on a real machine.

findings.title: Third-party render dependencies + CSP-blocked scripts
findings.description: lucide icons load from unpkg.com (third-party render dependency); @vercel/analytics is CSP-blocked; AdSense loader is CSP-blocked.
findings.recommendation: Bundle lucide locally (or inline needed icons); whitelist analytics/ads domains in CSP or remove them.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider
llms.txt (200) and llms-full.txt (33KB) published with product summary, pricing, and topic index
FAQPage schema on posts feeds direct AI answers; broad topical coverage across 10,000+ glossary terms
Descriptive title/description pairs on most pages make them citable

findings.title: llms.txt data-quality bugs
findings.description: [null] entry for /blog/generic-hero; stale counts (18 blog / 95 tools vs live 58 / 37).
findings.recommendation: Regenerate llms.txt from the live sitemap with corrected counts.

findings.title: Citation-blocking content errors
findings.description: Broken JSON-LD and 404 glossary URLs dilute passage-level citability for AI crawlers that validate sources.
findings.recommendation: Fixing the JSON-LD and 404 issues above also improves AI citation reliability.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Most pages carry zero or one image (fast, low bloat)
Alt text present on sampled images
Self-hosted PNG heroes deployed for most posts (picsum hotlink mostly removed)

findings.title: Alt-attribute HTML corruption on blog heroes
findings.description: Glossary-link injection writes raw <a> HTML inside alt attributes on some posts (e.g. youtube-shorts-seo-guide-2026).
findings.recommendation: Fix the injector to skip attribute contexts; regenerate affected posts.

findings.title: External image hotlink remains
findings.description: youtube-description-templates-2026 still loads its hero from picsum.photos (unreliable, no ownership).
findings.recommendation: Replace with a self-hosted branded hero like the other posts.

findings.title: No next-gen formats or explicit dimensions everywhere
findings.description: Heroes are PNG (not WebP/AVIF); some lack width/height (CLS risk on load).
findings.recommendation: Convert heroes to WebP with width/height attributes; add srcset.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Purge ~3,000 404 glossary URLs from sitemap (generate from live-verified URLs only); add CI broken-link check
Fix blog JSON-LD escaping in template + re-render affected posts (7/14 sampled broken)
Fix glossary-link injection into alt attributes; re-render affected posts
Add pagead2.googlesyndication.com + cdn.jsdelivr.net to CSP so AdSense and analytics load
Exclude 5 noindex core URLs from sitemap

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Resolve 24 blog/tools cannibalization pairs (301 losers, one home per keyword)
Make /about indexable with named founder + author bylines (E-E-A-T)
Add security headers (XFO, nosniff, Referrer-Policy) + security.txt
Trim blog/tools titles to <=60 chars in generators
Add lastmod to glossary URLs in sitemap generator

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand thin tool pages (109-172 words -> 500+ with how-to/FAQ)
Human review/fact-check gate on the blog publishing workflow
Flesh out blog category hubs; vary glossary boilerplate
Build a real indexable /pricing page; fix /guide 404 + /blog/generic-hero placeholder
Bundle lucide locally; convert blog heroes to WebP

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect GOOGLE_API_KEY (CrUX field data) + GSC for indexation monitoring
Backlink program (domain absent from Common Crawl) — directories, GitHub, HARO
Re-run this audit monthly; add schema-validation and broken-link CI gates
